annotations.title: Check Pine Script® with LuxAlgo's linter

description: Checks a Pine Script® source with LuxAlgo's linter, the one Quant checks its own scripts with: whether it is valid (no errors), every error and warning with its code, message and position (1-based line and column), and what the script declares (indicator, strategy or library, its title, Pine version and overlay). It reads the source only: nothing runs, nothing is saved, and it uses no Quant usage. Use it before telling the member a script works, and after editing one by hand. To have the errors fixed, pass the script to quant_generate_pine_script. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

code.description: The complete Pine Script® source to check.

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."
